segments.name: North America Automotive
segments.description: Distributes automotive replacement parts, accessories, tools and equipment in the U.S. and Canada to commercial and retail customers.
segments.evidence: Our North America Automotive segment operates in the United States and Canada through our Napa Auto Parts ("NAPA") subsidiaries, headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and UAP Inc., headquartered in Montreal, Canada.

segments.name: Industrial
segments.description: Distributes industrial replacement parts and value-added solutions across diverse end markets in North America, Australasia and Asia.
segments.evidence: Our Industrial business operated in the U.S., Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Indonesia and Singapore and accounted for 37% of total revenues.

revenueModel.text: Customers, primarily commercial repair shops and retail DIY consumers, pay GPC for automotive and industrial replacement parts and related solutions distributed through its store and distribution networks.
revenueModel.evidence: Together, these segments serve over one million customer locations including repair shops, dealerships, fleet operators, and retail consumers by delivering extensive product offerings with speed and reliability.

changes.text: In 2025, GPC disaggregated its automotive aftermarket business into two reportable segments, North America Automotive and International Automotive, with no changes to the Industrial segment.
changes.evidence: In the fourth quarter of 2025, we disaggregated our automotive aftermarket business into two reportable segments.
